text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Bring on the happy! Happy birthday,
Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-huh?! You really remembered my
birthday?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh! I never forget the
birthdays of
people I've read horoscopes
for!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I've come here today to do
a special
birthday reading, just for you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-wow, you'd do that for someone like
me?
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll start off with palm reading,
then
fortune reading, and then face
reading!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're going to do three whole
different
readings?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But wait, there's more! Flower reading,
astrology,
tasseography—we might as
well do them all!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-wow! You'd really do all that for me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that's why I'm here! Doto,
let's fill this
year full with fortune!
